translation: <ins>Dao Chuang Yao (刀瘡藥)</ins> Treats all wounds from metal blades; applied to stop bleeding, close the wound, settle pain, and protect against wind. Calcined white gypsum (上白石膏, calcined, one jin), purified plank rosin (淨板松香, extracted with water, one jin), pearl (珍珠, boiled with tofu, five qian). Grind the above three ingredients together into a fine powder, combine into one, store in a porcelain jar for use. <ins>Hunyuan Ointment (混元膏)</ins> <ins>Bālí Powder (八釐散)</ins> (both seen in the crown injury.
